About the job

Growth & Strategy Analyst

Ciudad de México | Modelo híbrido | Tiempo completo




En MexStrategy buscamos incorporar a una persona con ambición de crecer profesionalmente, criterio y alta capacidad de organización para fortalecer la gestión comercial, operativa y de crecimiento de la firma.

Somos una firma de estrategia e inversión que acompaña a empresas, instituciones y actores públicos en la estructuración y ejecución de proyectos complejos en México. Trabajamos en la intersección entre infraestructura, inversión, gobierno y estrategia, con un equipo compacto que da a quienes se incorporan exposición directa a los socios fundadores desde el inicio de su carrera.




Esta posición es ideal para alguien con mentalidad estructurada, capacidad analítica y disposición para construir procesos en un entorno dinámico y de alto aprendizaje, participando en iniciativas estratégicas y proyectos de alto impacto desde etapas tempranas de su carrera.




Misión del rol

Convertir la actividad comercial y estratégica de la firma en seguimiento disciplinado, pipeline claro, propuestas con siguiente paso y visibilidad oportuna para la toma de decisiones, con impacto directo en el crecimiento de MexStrategy.




Responsabilidades principales

Transformar información comercial y ejecutiva en visibilidad clara para la toma de decisiones, asegurando un CRM y pipeline confiables que impulsen el avance de oportunidades estratégicas.
Acompañar la evolución de prospectos y oportunidades desde el primer contacto hasta su conversión en proyectos, asegurando continuidad y seguimiento disciplinado.
Generar inteligencia operativa mediante agendas ejecutivas, minutas estratégicas y reportes que faciliten la coordinación y el avance de iniciativas clave.
Desarrollar y estructurar materiales, propuestas, presentaciones y documentación que fortalezcan procesos comerciales y relaciones con clientes y aliados.
Identificar, organizar y dar tracción a oportunidades de negocio, alianzas estratégicas y nuevas iniciativas de crecimiento para la firma.
Aprovechar herramientas digitales e inteligencia artificial para optimizar procesos, mejorar la productividad y fortalecer la capacidad de ejecución del equipo.
Contribuir al diseño y fortalecimiento de procesos comerciales y operativos que apoyen el crecimiento sostenible de la firma.




Perfil requerido

Licenciatura concluida en Administración, Negocios Internacionales, Economía, Finanzas, Ingeniería Industrial, Comunicación, Relaciones Internacionales o carrera afín, con perfil analítico y orientado a resultados.
1 a 3 años de experiencia profesional en operaciones, coordinación ejecutiva, project coordination, business development support, consultoría o servicios profesionales (se consideran perfiles con menor experiencia si el desempeño académico/analítico es sobresaliente).
Excelente capacidad de organización, priorización, seguimiento y atención al detalle.
Excelente redacción ejecutiva en español; inglés profesional, oral y escrito (nivel intermedio/avanzado).
Discreción para manejar información sensible.
Alto nivel de autonomía, criterio y disposición para ejecutar con rigor.




Valoraremos especialmente

Dominio total del inglés.
Experiencia previa con CRM y herramientas de seguimiento comercial y tareas (Hubspot, Notion, Airtable, ClickUp, Asana, Monday o similares).
Experiencia en firmas de consultoría, desarrollo de negocios, atracción de inversión, relaciones institucionales o entornos corporativos dinámicos.
Familiaridad con herramientas de inteligencia artificial generativa para productividad.
Interés por temas de inversión, competitividad, desarrollo económico y expansión empresarial.
Capacidad para trabajar en entornos donde los procesos se están construyendo y mejorando continuamente.

Visibilidad transversal sobre las oportunidades, proyectos y relaciones estratégicas de la firma, desde el inicio de tu trayectoria en MexStrategy.

About the job

About Signify

Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.

At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.

Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.

More About The Role

We’re looking for an Intern to join our Consumer Channel team in Mexico.

Working for Signify means being creative and adaptive. Our culture of continuous learning and commitment to diversity and inclusion creates an environment that allows you to build your skills and career. Together, we’re transforming our industry.

As the world leader in lighting, we’re constantly ahead of the curve. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we’re breaking new grounds in data analytics, AI, and smart homes, offices, cities and more!

Signify is proud to be a leader in climate action, acting in line with the latest climate science. We are committed to reaching net zero greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by 2040.

As an Intern / Apprentice you’ll be responsible for supporting Sales team and SOM role to improve customer service level in all the region (MEX & NOLA).

We’re on the lookout for forward-thinking innovators with a passion for sustainability. If you match this description, get in touch!

What You’ll Do


Sales Dashboard construction
Inventory level tracking (on hand / in transit) – Signify and Customer analysis
Slowmovers Action Tracker development
Sell In / Sell Out Consolidation ( 12 – 24 months)
Provisions report


Your Qualifications


Industrial Engineering or Business student (graduating after June 2027)
Intermediate English
Excel proficiency
Proactive


Our candidate profile is just a guide. We know that many talented people only apply for jobs when there is an exact match. If you don't fit all the criteria but believe this role is for you, we would very much like to hear from you.

We’re offering multiple opportunities for career development, like mentoring, coaching and stretch assignments, with strong international exposure for dynamic profiles. Learning is fundamental to our culture. Through continuous learning, we are transforming the industry. You have the chance to learn every day, acquire new skills and perspectives through customized online programs, and on-the-job experiences.

See #SignifyLife through the eyes of our employees!

Everything we’ll do for you

You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.

Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

description:
About the job

Company Description Blue Trail Software is a global software development company specializing in sophisticated applications for mobile, web, and back-end platforms, as well as QA solutions. The team works with technology clients primarily on the West Coast of the USA, from ambitious start-ups to established industry leaders. With offices across the USA, Argentina, Mexico, Uruguay, and Spain, the company offers a multicultural, distributed work environment. Blue Trail Software is committed to agile, resilient operations and the empowerment of all stakeholders, emphasizing diversity, engagement, responsibility, and autonomy. The organization is long-term oriented and supports employees in building lasting careers within the company.




Role Description 

Blue Trail is seeking a Social Media Specialist who can build our online authority, trust, and visibility through a professional thought leadership storytelling approach. This is a strategic role, not about chasing trends, but about crafting a coherent narrative, amplifying our expertise, and improving our credibility across social platforms and professional networks. 




Requirements




Core Skills

Strong storytelling instincts and content strategy thinking.
Ability to make complex or technical topics accessible and engaging.
Strong writing and editing skills with high attention to detail.
Strong understanding of brand consistency and positioning.
Excellent organizational and planning skills.
Ability to manage multiple content streams and deadlines. 




Communication & Collaboration 

Fluent in written and spoken English. 
Comfortable collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly.




Industry Fit

Interest in tech, software, engineering, QA, AI, or consulting topics. 
Basic understanding of SEO, social performance metrics, and platform analytics. 




Nice to Have

Experience in tech, software, engineering, or consulting environments. 
Familiarity with LinkedIn as a primary B2B growth channel. 
Experience building authority-driven or thought-leadership content. 




What This Role Is Not 

Not a meme account manager.
Not influencer-style content. 
Not a trend-chasing, TikTok-only role. 




This is a credibility-building, brand-defining position focused on establishing BTS as a trusted authority and shortening the sales cycle through professional, consistent, and strategic social content.




Key Responsibilities 




1. Social Media Strategy & Planning 

Develop and execute a comprehensive social media strategy aligned with BTS’ business goals.
Translate BTS’ technical expertise (engineering, QA, AI, UX) into clear, engaging content pillars.
Plan and maintain monthly content calendars, ensuring narrative consistency. 
Monitor social media performance with regular SEO and engagement reports, adjusting strategy as needed. 
Identify opportunities to increase online visibility (e.g., creating profiles on DesignRush, Clutch, and other industry platforms). 




2. Content Creation & Social Media Management

Craft strong captions that balance technical accuracy, clarity, and warmth. 
Schedule and manage posts across LinkedIn (primary), X, Facebook, YouTube, and other relevant channels. 
Maintain consistent tone, style, and messaging across all content. 
Manage light community engagement where needed. 
Support the development of CEO LinkedIn content and thought leadership pieces, including managing profile and posting. 
Support internal posting on Instagram (employees’ focus) 




3. Performance Monitoring & Iteration

Track metrics including engagement, reach, and qualitative feedback. 
Analyze SEO and social performance to inform content adjustments.
Iteratively improve content to maximize visibility, credibility, and lead conversion potential. 




4. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Work 

Work closely with Marketing and collaborate occasionally with engineers, QA, and UX teams to source content and insights.
Coordinate with internal design and video teams to align content production.
Support broader brand-building initiatives across departments.

About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. description:
About the job

Description

The Amazon Digital and Emerging Payments Team’s vision is to delight our customers with the best payment experience in the world! To achieve this vision, we are in search of a talented Software Developer who is customer obsessed and is focused on delivering first class quality products to our customers.

Our team takes a world view of payments for all of Amazon and builds highly customized and seamless payment experiences for our global customers. This focuses on geography and customer requires working on different technologies such as Android, Amazon Fire, and back-end platform systems in order to meet the needs of our customers. Our back-end systems are always available and guarantee that our customers' orders are never lost and always processed even when downstream services are down.

We are looking for a software development Engineer to play a key role in the Digital Payments & Emerging Markets (DEP) team, primarily building Amazon's Mexico Payments Products. This role offers exciting challenges and the opportunity to influence and drive a growing payments area.

This is a great opportunity to get on the ground floor of a team being setup to step change the customer experience in payments. Don't let it pass by!

Key job responsibilities

As a Developer, You Will

Help drive the architecture and technology choices that enable a world-class experience for our developers

Utilize various metrics sources to deliver rapid iterations of software features

Solve difficult problems with elegant and practical code

Raise the bar on quality, consistency, maintainability, efficiency, security and all the other things that make great software

Be responsible for designing, developing and deploying medium to large sized projects

Help define engineering best practices

Be a champion for the user: Insist on the highest standards, create functional and engaging features, and ensure their needs always come first.

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust

Mentorship& Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Basic Qualifications


 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 Experience programming with at least one software programming language


Preferred Qualifications


 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:
About the job

Ovation Law Firm is a fast-growing law firm dedicated to delivering outstanding legal services while fostering a supportive and innovative workplace. As we continue to expand, we are seeking a motivated and resourceful Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our team. This role is central to building the foundation of our workforce by attracting, sourcing, and hiring top talent across various roles—most of which are remote.

Position Overview

The Talent Acquisition Specialist will be responsible for the full recruitment lifecycle, including crafting compelling job ads, sourcing and headhunting qualified candidates, managing applicant pipelines, and supporting hiring managers throughout the interview and selection process. You will help shape our recruiting strategy to ensure we consistently attract the best talent to support our firm’s growth.

Key Responsibilities


Develop and post job ads across multiple platforms (LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, niche job boards, etc.).
Source, headhunt, and engage passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean searches, and networking.
Screen resumes, conduct initial interviews, and manage candidate pipelines.
Operate and optimize our ATS (create requisitions, workflows, scorecards; keep stages clean; run reports; maintain data hygiene).
Partner with department directors to understand role requirements and align recruiting strategies.
Maintain an organized applicant tracking process to ensure a smooth candidate experience.
Track and analyze recruiting metrics (time-to-fill, source-of-hire, pipeline health) to improve efficiency and quality of hire.
Promote Ovation Law Firm’s employer brand to attract top talent.


Qualifications


Proven experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, or headhunting (law firm or professional services experience a plus).
Hands-on ATS experience is required — e.g., BambooHR, JazzHR, Workable, Lever, Greenhouse, or similar (setup, workflows, templates, reporting).
Strong knowledge of job boards, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing platforms.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage both active and passive candidates.
Ability to manage multiple searches simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time-management skills.
Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
Must be available to work USA Pacific Standard Time (PST) hours.


Compensation & Benefits


Competitive compensation with a yearly bonus opportunity.
Work remotely with a collaborative, supportive team.
Paid Holidays.
Paid time off (PTO).
Opportunities for growth and to shape recruiting processes and strategy.


Why Join Us?


Be part of a growing law firm with a strong reputation and ambitious goals.
Collaborative, supportive, and forward-thinking team culture.
Remote flexibility with opportunities to shape recruiting processes and strategy.
Competitive compensation and opportunities for growth.

What You’ll Do

Ready to take your career global?

Great customer experiences start with quality. Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative — always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

description:
About the job

About The Role

The SEO & Web Acquisition Analyst owns two deeply connected surfaces: organic search as an acquisition channel, and the company website as the primary conversion environment for new users.

This is not a role where SEO and web are treated as separate workstreams handed off to different teams. Here, they are one because ranking for the right keywords only matters if the page those users land on converts them into FTDs. You own the full journey from search intent to first deposit, and you are accountable for both the traffic and what happens to it.

You will think like an SEO strategist, act like a web product owner, and measure everything against one north star: acquisition.

Core Responsibilities

SEO Organic Acquisition


Own the end-to-end SEO strategy: keyword research, content architecture, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and link building.
Build and maintain a keyword universe mapped to acquisition intent prioritizing terms that drive users likely to convert to FTD, not just traffic volume.
Conduct regular technical SEO audits and drive resolution of issues (crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, structured data) in partnership with Engineering.
Develop content briefs and SEO guidelines for internally or externally produced content, ensuring every piece serves an acquisition purpose.
Monitor algorithm updates and assess impact on rankings and organic FTD flow; adapt strategy accordingly.
Build and execute a link acquisition strategy focused on domain authority and referral traffic quality.


Web Ownership Conversion & Experience


Own the company website as an acquisition asset: you are responsible for its performance, structure, and ability to convert visitors into registered and depositing users.
Define and maintain the website roadmap prioritizing changes that directly impact acquisition metrics (landing page performance, conversion rate, load speed, UX clarity).
Partner with Design and Engineering to implement web improvements with speed; write clear briefs, QA releases, and own the outcome.
Run structured CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) experiments on key acquisition pages: homepages, landing pages, sign-up flows, and campaign-specific URLs.
Ensure that all paid, affiliate, and organic traffic lands on pages optimized for the context in which users were acquired no generic landing pages where tailored ones would convert better.
Maintain the website's technical health in coordination with Engineering: uptime, page speed, mobile experience, and tracking integrity.


Analytics & Reporting


Own SEO and web performance reporting: organic sessions, keyword rankings, organic-attributed FTDs, landing page conversion rates, and bounce rates.
Work with the BI Lead to ensure organic and web conversion events are correctly tracked and attributed in the acquisition funnel.
Translate data into clear action: surface insights proactively, not just in scheduled reports.


Requirements


3+ years of experience in SEO and/or web management with a clear focus on user acquisition or conversion outcomes.
Strong command of SEO tools: Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, and GA4.
Proven ownership of a website or set of landing pages with measurable impact on conversion or acquisition metrics.
Solid understanding of technical SEO: site architecture, Core Web Vitals, schema markup, rendering (including JS-heavy frameworks).
Experience running CRO experiments you know how to design a test, read results, and implement winners.
Comfortable working with Design and Engineering: you can write a tight brief, give precise feedback, and push for fast execution.
Data-driven by default: you measure the impact of everything you do.


Nice to Have


Experience with programmatic SEO or landing page generation at scale.
Familiarity with A/B testing tools (Optimizely, VWO, or similar) and feature flagging systems.
Basic HTML/CSS knowledge enough to QA implementations and unblock small fixes without Engineering.

About the job

I’m helping Decolure find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of DTC Operations Lead.




You'll drive DTC execution velocity and revenue growth by leading a data-driven team to ship impactful work.




Compensation:

USD 4K - 9K/month




Location:

Remote: Mexico




Mission of Decolure:

"We specialize in transforming a house into a home that the buyer is looking for, or a space that perfectly reflects your family’s style, needs and comfort (redesign)."




What makes you a strong candidate:

You are proficient in Shopify Plus, Shopify, Paid media, Meta Ads Manager, Linear.
You have +4 years experience in Direct-to-consumer marketing (DTC marketing).
English - Fully fluent




Responsibilities and more:

JOB TITLE: DTC Operations Lead

LOCATION: Remote

EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full Time




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a DTC Operations Lead to be the single owner of execution velocity for our Shopify direct-to-consumer channel. This is the most critical hire in our DTC buildout. We already have the strategy, the specs, the infrastructure, and the data — what we need is someone to make sure the work actually ships, every day, every week, without strategic conversations getting stuck in a document on Google Drive.

You will NOT be the person running ad accounts (that's the Growth Marketer). You will NOT be the person writing Liquid code (that's Implementation Specialist). You will NOT be the person producing creative assets (that's UGC Creators + Content Producer). Your job is to make sure ALL of those people are shipping, on-brief, on-time, every single week — and that the work they produce moves our DTC readiness score, revenue, and margin in the right direction.

This role is 70% execution management, 20% strategic decision-making, 10% hands-on analytical work. If you want to run ads or build pages yourself, this is not the right role. If you thrive on turning chaos into rhythm and watching a team ship more in a month than most DTC teams ship in a quarter, keep reading.




ABOUT US

Decolure is a US-based e-commerce company generating $18M+ annually on Amazon, with expanding presence on TikTok Shop and DTC Shopify. We operate 5 private label brands with 20+ active products across the portfolio.

What makes us different: we're building one of the most data-driven operations in the private label space. Our team uses advanced analytics, AI-powered operational agents, custom data pipelines, and structured decision frameworks to manage every aspect of the business , from keyword-level PPC decisions to inventory forecasting to competitive intelligence. This isn't a company where you'll be making gut calls. Every decision is backed by data, and every action plan has measurable outcomes.

We're a 27-person distributed team across the world. We operate in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment where ownership and accountability matter more than hours logged.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Execution Velocity & Team Management — 50% of your time

Daily standup (async or sync) with Growth Marketer, Implementation Specialist, UGC Creators — 15 minutes max, focused on "what shipped yesterday, what ships today, what's blocked"

ClickUp ownership: every open task has a clear owner, deadline, and acceptance criteria; every completed task has a tested outcome

Weekly sprint planning from the backlog of 17 existing specs + incoming priorities

Weekly sprint review: what shipped, what slipped, why, and what changes next week

Remove blockers: if Implementation Specialist is stuck on a Klaviyo flow, you unblock within 24 hours — you don't let it sit for a week

Pull from the AI agent's prioritized recommendations and assign — you should never have a team member wondering what to work on

DTC Performance Accountability — 20% of your time

Own the top-line DTC KPIs: revenue, conversion rate, CAC, AOV, email list growth, repeat purchase rate, contribution margin

Weekly performance review with the team, using data from the AI agent's dashboards

Monthly performance review with the CEO: what moved, what didn't, why, and what you're changing

Quarterly P&L review: contribution margin, LTV:CAC, channel profitability

Accountable for moving the DTC Readiness Tracker from 62% to 90% within 90 days of starting

Strategic Decision-Making — 20% of your time

Decide what the team works on this week, this month, this quarter — aligned with CEO priorities

Evaluate competing priorities: when the agent surfaces a conversion leak vs. the Growth Marketer wants to test a new creative vs. Ahmad has a blog CTA to ship, you prioritize

Approve or reject A/B test recommendations (with data justification)

Approve creative briefs before UGC creators start production

Cross-channel coordination: when Amazon runs a promotion, you decide DTC's response; when TikTok wants to test a creator, you validate the DTC implications

Escalate to CEO only what requires CEO-level decisions (budget above $500/day, pricing changes, strategic shifts) — you handle everything else

Hands-On Analytical Work — 10% of your time

Read dashboards daily — you should know the top 5 DTC metrics before your team tasks

Read Microsoft Clarity session recordings weekly (not optional) — you should know firsthand where users get stuck on mobile

Spot-check the AI agent's recommendations — verify the logic, don't just rubber-stamp

Identify when the AI agent is missing context and feed it back (this makes the agent better over time)

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (90-DAY SCORECARD)

Month 1 — Command of the Team

Daily standup rhythm established with all team members

ClickUp fully groomed: every open task has owner, deadline, acceptance criteria

Weekly sprint + review cadence operating

All 17 existing specs triaged and prioritized into a 12-week roadmap

First 5 specs shipped to production (not just drafted — LIVE)

You can verbally walk the CEO through current DTC performance, top risks, and this week's priorities in 5 minutes without notes

Month 2 — Execution at Pace

At least 10 specs shipped to production (cumulative from month 1)

DTC Readiness Tracker moved from 62% to 72%+

Store-wide conversion rate improved 0.2pp+ from baseline

Meta ROAS above 1.5x sustained

Email list growth accelerating (measurable WoW)

Zero specs older than 30 days sitting "in progress" — everything moves or gets killed

Month 3 — DTC Revenue Inflection

DTC revenue trajectory toward $30K+/month

DTC Readiness Tracker at 85%+

Blended ROAS above 2x sustained

CAC trending toward $15 target

Team is operating without needing daily direction — sprint cadence is self-sustaining

Clear strategic plan for months 4-6 submitted to CEO




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Must-Have Experience (Non-Negotiable):

4+ years leading DTC e-commerce operations (Shopify, BigCommerce, or direct Shopify Plus) at a brand doing $500K-$10M/year

Demonstrable track record of running a cross-functional DTC team: paid media, CRO, email, content, implementation

Experience managing remote teams across time zones (you will manage people in 2-4 countries simultaneously)

Project management fluency: ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Linear, Monday — doesn't matter which, but you must have run a real backlog, not a checklist

Data literacy: you can read GA4, Shopify Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Klaviyo, and Search Console fluently — not an expert in each, but competent enough to verify a specialist's work

Strong communication: written (async updates, briefs, escalation emails) and verbal (CEO check-ins, team standups)

Fluent English: written and verbal — this is a CEO-facing and team-leadership role

Strong Preferences:

Experience at a company running DTC alongside Amazon (cross-channel dynamics are a daily reality here)

Experience with bedding, home, wellness, or premium lifestyle brands

Experience working with AI tools as part of daily workflow (not just "used ChatGPT a few times")

Shopify Plus admin experience (not required, but a plus)

Klaviyo, Microsoft Clarity, Judge.me, Gorgias, or similar tool fluency

Nice-to-Have:

Background as a former Growth Marketer or CRO specialist (you understand what your team is doing at a technical level)

Experience in a 5-10 person company (you understand scrappy execution, not Fortune 500 bureaucracy)

Experience building or scaling a DTC channel from <$500K to $2M+ ARR

Comfort with light Shopify theme edits, basic HTML/Liquid (so you can spot-check work)




WHAT WE PROVIDE

A fully built strategic and data infrastructure: 17 specs, 86 processes documented, 35+ automation scripts, 13 active crons, all platform APIs integrated

An AI operations agent that delivers daily analytics, weekly summaries, competitor intel, creative briefs, PDP audit specs, email flow designs, and P&L analysis — you inherit a research and planning team on day 1

A 90-day playbook to move DTC Readiness from 62% to 90% — not a blank page

Direct CEO access for decisions above your authority level — clear escalation path, no middle-management bureaucracy

Growing revenue trajectory: DTC is our #1 strategic growth priority for 2026-2027

Clear promotion path: as DTC scales to $2M+ ARR, this role evolves into Head of DTC




DEAL-BREAKERS — DO NOT APPLY IF:

Your experience is primarily Amazon or marketplace operations — the playbooks don't transfer

You've only ever been an individual contributor (paid media specialist, CRO analyst) — this is a management role requiring team leadership

You've only ever led large teams (15+ people with clear functional silos) — this is a scrappy execution role where you lead 4-6 people across functions

You prefer strategy over execution — this is 70% execution, 20% strategy, 10% analysis

You need extensive direction from above — you will be given goals and scorecards, not task lists

You're uncomfortable delegating to an AI agent or receiving AI-generated specs — that's a core workflow of this role




WHAT YOU'LL GET

Competitive salary based on experience

Fully remote position. 

Direct access to the CEO. Your ideas and analysis reach the decision-maker, not a middle manager

Advanced tooling and infrastructure, including AI-powered analytics, custom dashboards, and automated reporting that let you focus on strategy instead of data entry

A team that values data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement

Opportunities for growth as the company expands into new marketplaces and channels

Employee discounts on Decolure products




Your potential leader(s):

Erik Fisher -



Desired Skills and Experience

Direct-to-consumer marketing (DTC marketing), Shopify Plus, Shopify, Paid media, Meta Ads Manager, Linear, Klaviyo, Growth marketing, Google Search Console, Data analysis

title: Volunteer Marketing and Communications Lead to Connect Stakeholders Working to End Deep Polarization with Colombia Construye Confianza
description:
About the job

This is an opportunity to work with an Ashoka Fellow 

Ashoka Fellows are leading social entrepreneurs that have been taken through a rigorous selection process, testing the quality of their ideas and character, to become part of the Ashoka Fellowship and Network. Ashoka Fellows take on the challenges of building innovative system change ideas to make and spread social impact in a world wrought with challenges. They refuse to let the ‘impossible’ stand in their way to creating a better world.

This is an unpaid, volunteer opportunity

About The Affiliated Organization

Colombia Construye Confianza (CCC) was founded to address one of Colombia's most urgent social challenges: deep polarization among citizens who have lost the ability to trust one another. We work with communities, organizations, and institutions to transform the way people relate, building the social trust that democracy and coexistence require. Our flagship methodology, BAKONDO, has reached over 3,200 people over more than 20 years, earning recognition from the World Economic Forum, Coca-Cola, and One Young World. Through experiential education, play, and art, we bring together volunteers and vulnerable communities to form empathetic leaders. Our most powerful program, BAKONDO Paz, unites ex-combatants, victims of the armed conflict, and social leaders to run a camp for children in vulnerable situations, turning former adversaries into builders of peace.

For more information, please visit www.colombiaconstruyeconfianza.org

Job Description

Colombia Construye Confianza is seeking a strategic marketing volunteer to help us design and deploy a comprehensive communications strategy that connects us with all our key stakeholders. We recently developed our brand concept and initial materials with a creative agency, and now need someone to take that foundation and turn it into an active, results-driven marketing operation. The volunteer will design the overall communications and marketing strategy for CCC and its initiatives, including our BAKONDO bootcamps. They will define the right channels, messages, and tactics to attract volunteers, corporate partners, donors, universities, and impact investors. They will also help manage and optimize our social media presence across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp, and support the team in executing campaigns consistently. Their work will directly determine how many people discover, trust, and join our mission, making it essential to the growth and sustainability of the organization. Please let us know today if you can help!

Volunteer Logistics

Estimated hours required per week: 5

The estimated duration of the project is: 3-6 months

This position is Virtual (Remote)

Language Requirements

Spanish

Desired Skills And Experience

We are looking for a professional with demonstrated experience in marketing strategy and digital communications, ideally within the social impact, NGO, or purpose-driven brand space. The ideal candidate has strong skills in content strategy, social media management, and audience segmentation, and knows how to translate a compelling mission into messages that move people to act. Experience working with multiple stakeholder audiences (corporate, institutional, and grassroots) is highly valued. Proficiency in Spanish is required; English is a plus. A background in impact communications, social entrepreneurship, or international development will help the volunteer hit the ground running.

About the job

Oportunidad profesional en Inteligencia Artificial

Estamos en búsqueda de Ingenieros y/o especialistas en Inteligencia Artificial con mentalidad innovadora y pasión por construir soluciones avanzadas basadas en datos. Esta persona participará en el diseño e implementación de sistemas inteligentes que aprovechen modelos de lenguaje de última generación, Python y el ecosistema de Google Cloud Platform.




El rol está enfocado en el desarrollo de agentes inteligentes y arquitecturas basadas en Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) para resolver desafíos complejos y habilitar nuevas capacidades tecnológicas dentro de la organización.




Principales funciones

Desarrollo de agentes inteligentes

Construir soluciones autónomas basadas en modelos de lenguaje avanzados (familia Gemini u otros), capaces de automatizar procesos y mejorar la interacción con usuarios y sistemas.

Implementación de soluciones en la nube (GCP)

Diseñar, desplegar y operar aplicaciones de IA utilizando servicios como Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Functions y Kubernetes Engine.

Arquitecturas RAG

Diseñar pipelines que integren modelos de lenguaje con fuentes de conocimiento internas para generar respuestas contextualizadas, precisas y confiables.

Programación en Python

Desarrollar soluciones robustas utilizando herramientas del ecosistema de ciencia de datos y machine learning (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch o TensorFlow).

Optimización de prompts y evaluación de modelos

Diseñar estrategias de prompt engineering y métricas de evaluación que permitan mejorar el desempeño y confiabilidad de los modelos en entornos productivos.

Trabajo colaborativo con equipos multidisciplinarios

Convertir necesidades del negocio en soluciones técnicas y comunicar resultados de forma clara, mostrando el impacto en procesos y decisiones.




Perfil profesional

✔ 2 a 3 años de experiencia en Machine Learning, Data Science o AI Engineering.

✔ Dominio sólido de Python y librerías de análisis y aprendizaje automático.

✔ Experiencia trabajando con Google Cloud Platform, especialmente en servicios de IA y analítica.

✔ Formación en Ingeniería, Ciencias de la Computación, Matemáticas, Estadística o carreras afines.

✔ Conocimiento en LLMs, NLP, embeddings y arquitecturas modernas de modelos de lenguaje.




Se valorará adicionalmente

Experiencia práctica implementando arquitecturas RAG
Conocimiento de frameworks como LangChain, LlamaIndex u otros frameworks de agentes
Experiencia trabajando con Docker y Kubernetes
Manejo de bases de datos SQL y NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.)
Estudios de posgrado en Inteligencia Artificial o áreas relacionadas

description:
About the job

This is the role for you if you're genuinely obsessed with AI, not just using the tools, but actually thinking about where this is all going, and wanting to argue about it over coffee.

As a Product Manager, you'll lead the full lifecycle of client software builds from kickoff to launch: part product strategist, part UX thinker, part client partner. The best people in this seat don't just gather requirements; they look at a client's problem and ask "what would this look like if AI actually changed how this works," not just "how do we automate the boring part." If that question gets you excited rather than exhausted, keep reading.

What You'll Do


Manage product builds end-to-end: run kickoff calls, gather requirements, define MVPs, and oversee delivery
Transform client ideas into clear product specs, wireframes, and UX flows
